messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC0009812 fired for service=\"inference-api-prod\" (severity=P1). Trigger: >50 5xx in 2m. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC0009812 @here

alice: acked in PD, jumping on. joining bridge.

raj: on it — taking ownership from rotation. starting bridge https://meet.redwood/bridges/xyz

sarah (support): seeing customer reports of 502s on /v1/generate. ticket #4421 has details (AcmeCorp, BetaCo).

raj: thanks — can support paste top affected customer ids and sample request ids? need impact matrix.

sarah (support): paste: AcmeCorp = ~100% failed since 14:21Z, BetaCo ~40% errors, internal smoke failing. attaching logs in PD.

alice: quick triage — frontend is returning 502s, backend logs show kvcache misses/errors. tail:

```
2026-03-15T14:22:10Z inference-frontend ERROR upstream 502 \"KV_CACHE_MISS\"
2026-03-15T14:22:12Z model-worker WARN failed to load kv cache for session
```

simon: I pushed a soft-limit on pool-a to reduce concurrent sessions to 80% while we triage. rolling now (config change).

maria: if soft-limit doesn't stabilize, we should fall back some traffic to quantized model redwood-quant-7b in eu-west-1 to reduce memory pressure.

raj: initiating 30% traffic shift to fallback model now. command:

```
rdwctl route set inference-api-prod --model redwood-quant-7b --weight 30%
```

alice: also enabling prefix cache for common prompts while routing change propagates:

```
rdwctl cache prefix --service inference-api-prod --enable
```

sarah (support): drafting customer comms: \"We're aware of 502 errors for some API requests; engineers are investigating and mitigations are in progress.\" Send now? @raj

raj: send it. I'll update PD with mitigation steps and timeline.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident INC0009812 acknowledged by raj (on-call). Assigned to raj. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC0009812

maria: any early metrics? error rate trending down?

alice: error rate for /v1/generate dropped from ~55% -> ~18% within 3m after the route change. still residual spikes for BetaCo.

simon: found a noisy worker version (v1.14.7) causing kvcache thrash. rolled back to v1.14.6 on impacted nodes:

```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-worker -n prod --to-revision=3
```

raj: good catch. i'll keep the bridge for 30m and then handoff to simon for post-incident review if steady. :thumbsup:

sarah (support): customer comms sent. CS asked for ETA; told them we'll provide updates every 15m until stable. :eyes:

alice: added runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p1 — steps executed: route fallback, concurrency limit, rollback worker, enable prefix cache.

maria: please schedule a retro to revisit kvcache eviction thresholds and pooling defaults. logging this for postmortem.

raj: assigning postmortem owner: simon. will close PD after 30m of stable metrics.

oncall-bot: Incident INC0009812 status updated: MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Errors down to ~1% over 5m. Last update 14:26Z. :white_check_mark:

simon: will open the postmortem doc, include timeline and runbook gaps, and propose changes. assigning to simon.

alice: thx all — keeping notes in the incident doc. if anything flares, ping @raj immediately.
